core_obligations: Observe that fibre products of formal algebraic spaces are a special case of the general fibre-product lemma (proof lines 3526-3527).
Verify the hypothesis of that general lemma in this situation: formal algebraic spaces have representable diagonals (proof lines 3527-3529).
Conclude that the category of formal algebraic spaces over S has fibre products (proof line 3529).
proof_roadmap: Apply the general fibre-product lemma (proof lines 3526-3527).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the category of formal algebraic spaces over a scheme S has fibre products (statement lines 3520-3524). The proof exhibits the argument as a reduction to the general fibre-product lemma for sheaves over a base whose diagonal is representable by algebraic spaces, and identifies what supplies that hypothesis in the case at hand: formal algebraic spaces have representable diagonals, by the chapter's diagonal lemma (proof lines 3526-3529). The level is H2: the proof is two sentences, but it does the one thing this reduction requires -- naming which general statement applies and why its hypothesis is met here -- rather than merely citing a same-shaped result.
